referenceCamera.note: Orthographic-like front elevation; model-review perspective is framed to the full height.

silhouette.boundingShape: near-spherical globe over an upward-tapered rounded pedestal
silhouette.symmetry: bilateral exterior with asymmetric side crank

reasoning: Capsules require repeated two-shell construction and an animated dispense route.

specDepthDecision.rationale: Transparent repeated capsules and two articulated controls require a deep independent hierarchy.

details.description: Opaque star, flower, key and bear prize silhouettes remain readable inside the clear capsule halves.

definitionOfDone: Three elevations retain the globe/pedestal silhouette and component placement.
Capsules read as two-piece transparent/color shells with equator seams and visible programmatic prize contents.
Powered demo rotates both controls, agitates the capsule bed and internal prizes, delivers one prize-filled capsule to the tray and safely resets before 5.2 seconds.

featureGroups.name: Globe and lid
qualityCriteria: Near-spherical globe and domed lid retain observed proportions.

featureGroups.name: Base and dispense chute
qualityCriteria: Tapered pedestal and real arched cavity remain legible.

featureGroups.name: Capsules and controls
qualityCriteria: Two-piece capsules and articulated controls remain separately readable.

featureGroups.name: Powered dispense action
qualityCriteria: One capsule follows a contained route and stops on the tray.

antiShallowSpecRules: No invented hidden mechanism described as observed.
mustNotDo: Do not merge moving controls into the base.
Do not let animation intersect the globe or pedestal.

componentTree.name: machine root
componentTree.topologyRationale: Container for the observed stacked assemblies; no visible geometry is fused here.

componentTree.name: transparent globe assembly
componentTree.topologyRationale: Visible shell is one smoothly varying near-spherical volume held between two rings.

componentTree.name: tapered pedestal assembly
componentTree.topologyRationale: Pedestal sides form a continuous rounded upward taper in all elevations.

componentTree.name: dispensing mechanism assembly
componentTree.topologyRationale: Observed controls and chute are discrete rigid subassemblies mounted to the pedestal.

componentTree.name: domed top lid
componentTree.topologyRationale: Domed cap is rotationally symmetric with a soft continuous crown and thick rim.

componentTree.name: clear globe shell
componentTree.topologyRationale: Transparent enclosure is a single near-spherical thin shell.

componentTree.name: globe lower seat ring
componentTree.topologyRationale: Two concentric molded lips visibly clamp the globe base.

componentTree.name: internal center column
componentTree.topologyRationale: Visible straight pink spine descends from the lid into the capsule bed.

componentTree.name: two-piece capsule bed
componentTree.topologyRationale: Multiple rigid spherical capsules pack irregularly inside the globe.

localFeatures.attachment: child prize pivot inside each capsule pivot

componentTree.name: cream rounded frustum shell
componentTree.topologyRationale: Observed front and side faces taper continuously from a wide rounded foot to the narrow globe seat.

componentTree.name: front rotary crank
componentTree.topologyRationale: Round seat, transverse grip and center boss form a discrete front control.

componentTree.name: side crank lever
componentTree.topologyRationale: Slender bent arm connects a side axle hub to a spherical hand grip.

componentTree.name: arched dispense chute and tray
componentTree.topologyRationale: Observed assembly is a thick arched cavity plus a protruding tray lip with real negative space.

componentTree.name: rear service hatch
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thin rounded hatch rides on the rear pedestal face and does not alter the main silhouette.

componentTree.name: pink lower base ring
componentTree.topologyRationale: Thick molded ring is visually separated from the cream pedestal by a continuous seam.

componentTree.name: four low support feet
componentTree.topologyRationale: Four repeated low rounded supports ground the base in the three elevations.

repetitionSystems.geometry: separate upper hemisphere, lower hemisphere and equator ring per instance
repetitionSystems.instances: deterministic irregular 3D packing with pastel palette and varied orientation
repetitionSystems.distribution: three staggered depth layers inside globe
attached at each capsule local equator

repetitionSystems.geometry: beveled extruded star, flower, key or bear silhouette
repetitionSystems.instances: one opaque prize on an independent child pivot inside every capsule
repetitionSystems.distribution: four variants cycled through all visible capsules
repetitionSystems.variation: four shapes, four contrasting colors and contained local wobble

acceptance: Front/side silhouette and overall height ratio match reference.
Named parts touch parents and moving pivots remain at real joints.

buildPasses.goal: Refine domes, tapers, seams, cavities and capsule construction.
acceptance: Three-quarter view reads volumetric, not slab-like.

buildPasses.goal: Match pastel plastic and transparent polymer response.
acceptance: Transparent layers retain readable depth and pastel color separation.

buildPasses.goal: Verify neutral SAKURA toon light, outlines and contact shadows.
acceptance: Key/fill/rim explain form without hiding transparency.
One capsule reaches tray without intersections and reset is safe before 5.2 seconds.
Review diagnostics remain within 160 draw calls and 250k triangles.

featureReviewPolicy.selectionRule: review all critical and only suspicious important features

referencePbrExtraction.acceptedLimitation: Flat illustrated references contain baked highlights; procedural solid-color toon materials preserve SAKURA consistency more reliably than crop projection.

lightingFromPhoto: warm key light from upper front-left, intensity 3.2, soft shadow radius 4
cool fill light from front-right, intensity 1.35
pink rim light from rear-left, intensity 1.6
ACES-style exposure intent 1.0 with pale blue-grey background
contact shadow on circular ground plane at opacity 0.15

actionReadiness.contract: Named pivots and sockets expose all moving and serviceable assemblies.
authoringRules: Do not merge controls or capsules into base geometry.
Keep socket transforms local to their pivot.

proceduralStrategy: Build named assemblies and socketed controls.
Use deterministic repeated two-shell capsule groups.
Refine lathed tapers, real cavity depth, seams and highlight-catching bevels.
Apply SAKURA toon materials, outline hulls and transparent depth ordering.
Animate a single contained dispense route and reset safely.
Optimize only after final multiview review.

performanceBudget.optimizationPolicy: Reuse four shared prize geometries and materials across eleven capsule pivots; retain independent semantic groups.

assumptions: Inferred: internal divider wheel, anti-double-feed flap and curved drop channel are simplified into a hidden safe motion path.
Inferred: rear hatch depth and fastening method are conservative shallow molded geometry.
Inferred: underside screws and cable storage are omitted; four symmetric feet and a rear cable socket are provided.
Inferred: side crank and front crank share a hidden gear train; only visible controls are modeled.
risks: Transparent globe and clear capsule shells can lose readability under low contrast.
Dense capsule layout can produce alpha sorting artifacts.
Dispense path must stay forward of the opaque base shell to avoid clipping.

featureReviews.notes: The clear globe, low dome lid and seat ring preserve the reference identity.
Tapered cream pedestal and arched front chute match the reference architecture.
Multiple independent two-piece pastel capsules remain readable through the globe.
Front crank, side crank and output tray are separately modeled and animated.
Transparent globe no longer reads black and pastel capsules remain separated.
Crank rotation and capsule travel into the tray make the purpose unambiguous.

reviewHistory.summary: Four browser views preserve the globe, pedestal, chute, capsule system and independent controls; the powered crank-to-dispense sequence remains immediately readable.
mismatches: transparent globe and realtime shadows reduce deterministic mask agreement

visualEvidence.notes: 四个浏览器视图均已检查；确定性二值轮廓仅作为受构图和透明材质限制的辅助证据。
